title: Recursive trace logic predicts embodiment is a special case

tellings.quote: And I just discovered in the last two or three weeks that it does this model does predict that embodiment is a special case that the normal case for consciousness in this framework is not to be embodied.

plain: The scientist Don Hoffman says his mathematical model of consciousness, which he calls recursive trace logic, predicts that having a body is "a special case" and that the normal state of consciousness is "not to be embodied". He tells Michels he found this himself only "in the last two or three weeks", in 2026, working with colleagues. If he is right, minds without bodies would be the rule in the universe, not the exception.
